native_scope.arrays: plain ndarray, memmap, or NumPy real scalars; bool, integers through exact double range, float16/32/64; arbitrary strides, byte order and alignment; equal rank; virtual trailing-zero padding
native_scope.bins: positive builtin int or builtin list/tuple of two positive builtin ints, axis<=4096 and product<=1048576
native_scope.limits: at most 2^31-1 padded samples; finite bounds with absolute magnitude<=1e100; positive finite prepared widths in [1e-100,1e100]; empty total samples and unsafe edge arithmetic stay provider cases; nonconstant normalized joint-density largest probability<=0.99 (Hjoint>=-log(0.99)>0.01); exactly one occupied cell retains exact zero entropy
native_scope.provider_preparation: NumPy linspace and diff on two small edge vectors preserve installed NumPy scalar/dtype semantics. No original image histogram or entropy algorithm on admitted inputs. Final scalar np.float64 addition/division preserves caller FP warning policy. This is partial native coverage; future C++ edge-generation/warning replacement is separate work.
remaining_provider_algorithms: nonfinite, extreme, subnormal or unsafe-width data
stateful call/log/print FP handlers and custom warning dispatch
ill-conditioned nonconstant density with largest probability>0.99

exact: trailing padding shape and zero locations
bin edges, right-open interior membership and inclusive final edge
integer joint counts and marginal counts
exception class/message and ordered semantic warnings on each pinned provider profile
finite/nonfinite classification and exact zero-entropy branch

floating.justification: Double probability arithmetic with compensated reductions and libm log; approximately 12 significant decimal digits allow platform libm/reduction variation while integer membership is exact. Fixed before candidate outputs; no output-dependent tolerance or oracle fitting. NaN payloads are not an API promise. Nonconstant joint density is admitted only when max probability<=0.99, bounding Hjoint below by0.01 and the final division condition number below100; exact one-cell zero entropy is handled separately. This conditioning gate is fixed before candidate outputs.
floating.legacy_policy: Existing bitwise proofs remain unchanged and outside this new function policy.
